shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright stone monument
rounded oval/cartouche-like motifs with internal detail
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief carving with plump rounded oval cartouches containing schematic eyes and face-like features, and both fields are contained by a raised border, which gives a loose conventional resemblance in how forms are outlined and filled. The decisive difference is subject: A is a single large anthropomorphic figure with headdress, body and pendant ornament occupying the whole monument, while B is a regular grid of repeated sign-blocks in rows and columns with no figure at all.
